model_card.distribution: Not redistributed in the public release. Retrieve from the pinned official URL to check this hash.

method_reading_notes: Official example applies a task instruction to queries, but no instruction to retrieval documents.
Official Transformers example uses left padding, last-token pooling, L2 normalization and a maximum input length of 8192 tokens.
The 0.6B model provides 1024-dimensional embeddings; its supported context length is 32K. The present experiment uses the fixed 8192-token cap.
The card specifies Transformers >=4.51.0; this experiment pins 4.57.1.
